newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian 182-day T-bill rate falls to 9.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian 182-day T-bill rate falls to 9.95 pct.

text.p: The average yield on 182-day Lithuanian Treasury bills dipped to 9.95 percent from 10.86 percent at auction on Tuesday, the central bank said.
All amounts are in millions of litas.
MATURITY AVG YIELD LAST WEEK MIN/MAX ISSUE BID SOLD
The settlement date for today's auction is January 17 and the bills mature on August 18.
The next auctions are on January 20 when 50 million litas of 91-day paper will be offered and on January 21 when 30 million litas of 182-day paper will be auctioned.
